meta.name: mailglass brand tokens
meta.notes: Brand v2.0 (Sand, Espresso and Deep Glass on light; Roast, Bone and Bright Glass on dark). Hand-maintained: no generator writes this file or tokens.css (D-03). Two tiers: palette holds the raw values; color, logo, font, text, space, radius, and focus hold the semantic roles that pages reference. Every palette entry says where it comes from: $extensions.mailglass.book names its source in brandbook/v2/brand.json (list items matched by name), and $extensions.mailglass.designed records the two palette entries and the alpha of a designed composite. mailglass_admin/test/mailglass_admin/token_parity_test.exs proves this file equals tokens.css, the compiled admin bundle and brand.json. Color values are hex strings and dimensions are px strings. tokens.css carries the same values as CSS custom properties.
